name: YNX Bridge
title: YNX Bridge | Cross-network Evidence and Recovery
metaDescription: Inspect YNX Bridge route availability, lifecycle evidence, Provider health, exposure, reconciliation and recovery without confusing read-only status with asset delivery.
features: explicit source, proof, destination confirmation and asset-availability lifecycle
fail-closed Provider, route and token catalogs
public read-only Testnet status and evidence
risks: no approved executable YNX Bridge route is available
no funded YNX Testnet deposit or withdrawal has been verified
threshold-relayer attestations are not light-client or trustless consensus proofs
operator reconciliation is not independent chain proof

websiteVerification.gap: The fetched SPA shell uses the root canonical URL and generic site title and description. Owner 28-website must render route-specific canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD, title and description.

faq.question: Is YNX Bridge live?
faq.answer: A public read-only Testnet evidence surface is live, but no executable YNX Bridge route or user asset movement is enabled.

faq.question: When is a transferred asset available?
faq.answer: Only at destination_available with destinationAssetAvailable=true after verified destination evidence; destination confirmation alone is insufficient.

faq.question: Is Circle CCTP available for YNX?
faq.answer: The deployed service observes the official CCTP V2 Sandbox API on supported non-YNX domains. No approved or executable YNX CCTP route is verified.

faq.question: Are relayer attestations trustless proofs?
faq.answer: No. The implemented threshold-relayer verifier is not a light client and does not support a canonical or trustless Bridge claim.
